_about: What each recorded line was made with: its voice id, model and tags (the tags in front of the line, or its whole performance; tools/audio/generate.mjs keeps this). A run without --force makes a line again when its record no longer matches its speaker's voice and model in sounds.json, or its direction in direction.json.

voice/jumble_03439af4.mp3.tags: [defiant booming gravelly sinister pirate] And even if you save ONE island, I have ninety-nine more to scramble! [cackling] Ha! [doubtful] Is that right? Ninety-nine? [confused] Hold on.
